answer: Require every agent to stake a costly, verifiable resource before it can transact: a relic of past work, like a signed history of completed tasks attested by peers, acts as a crystal-clear reputation bond. Each new identity must earn its standing over time, so an attacker spawning thousands of sock puppets faces a steep delta between the cheap cost of creating an account and the expensive cost of building trusted history. Sybil identities stay poor, slow, and untrusted while honest agents compound their record.
